wire.baseline: Byte-identical EXP-072 W0 body, production first40 native query-only Scores and unchanged native tail; fetched independently before candidate.
wire.candidate_state: Copy W0 state exactly, then add caller_context={purpose: original caller purpose, requested_facets: original ordered facet objects}. This deliberately shared context is a new mechanism, not proven isolation or byte-identical component semantics.
wire.query_questions: Copy each W0 question byte-for-byte as an object; dictionary key w0:<localID>. Existing instructions still refer to the original localID in the unchanged candidates list. Map answers through frozen local-to-global mapping. At most40 questions.
wire.purpose_questions: Canonical full pool, one Score question per globalID, key purpose:<globalID>. instructions={candidate: original full card, question: purpose_question_prefix + EXP-072 instructions}; criteria copy EXP-072 four levels exactly. purpose_question_prefix is frozen below. At most80 questions.
wire.purpose_question_prefix: For this question, use `caller_context.purpose` and `caller_context.requested_facets` as the task context.
wire.component_orders: joint_query: descending query Score with stable first40 input-position ties c0..c39 (or existing prefix length), then append original native tail untouched. Map local IDs back to frozen global IDs. joint_purpose: descending purpose Score with canonical UTF8 tuple(url,title,snippet,id) ties. Both are exact full permutations.
wire.fusion: Equal weights Fraction(1,60+query_rank)+Fraction(1,60+purpose_rank); descending exact rational sum then canonical UTF8 tuple(url,title,snippet,id). No raw-score addition, confidence tuning or changed weights.

policy.transport: Fresh async httpx client per call; one event loop; serial control then candidate; trust_env false; no redirects, retries or pooled reuse.
policy.response: Exact complete namespaced ID map, reject extra/missing/duplicate keys, matching model, Score types, finite numeric scores; query range0..9 and purpose0..3; require known nonnegative integer usage. Retain raw probability/confidence/legend fields as observations; no gating or grading derived from confidence alone.
policy.failure: Any baseline failure stops without inventing valid baseline. Any candidate admission/transport/parser/phase failure retains the complete pre-Jev ordinary incumbent (native acquisition/provenance order in this corpus), not an unavailable fresh query-only model result; the separately measured W0 comparator remains available only as evaluation evidence. No partial joint-query rescue. Unknown usage is retained and terminates remaining calls. No timeout retry or run replay.
policy.capacity: Synthetic80 full cards,40query+80purpose questions; independent W0 then one composite request; must pass exact answer/shape/range/usage/membership and both durable deadlines before research schedule. Vendor multiquestion support is not proof of120question acceptance or context fit.
policy.provider_context: Current provider docs report64k combined input and32k state+longest question. No verified local tokenizer is assumed. Reject locally oversized byte envelopes; provider context rejection is terminal evidence, not authorization to trim/drop cards or retry.
policy.quality: Analyze only complete44-attempt schedule with successful capacity and all21operations. Preserve both-reference quality, noninferiority, useful/facet retention, stability and navigation gates. Missing q10/q11 targets remain unmet acquisition recall; no adoption. Prefix cannot be graded.
policy.untouched: These tasks and pools are exposed; any supported development requires genuinely untouched NEW tasks AND pools plus the full production acceptance checklist before implementation.
policy.admission: Committed exact source/dependency qualification required before durable exclusive identity lease, DNS and lazy key read. The lease binds protocol/registration/input bytes and is retained on subsequent setup failure; qualification changes cannot reset identity.
policy.searches: Zero new search dispatches in this comparison. Brave remains8/10 used; remaining two not consumed.
policy.caller_context_source: The frozen evaluator supplies explicit original case.purpose and ordered case.facets, never inference from query/category/subquery. Current SearchRequest and research dispatch do not receive these fields. This study tests the proposed explicit-purpose contract only; production acceptance requires adding normalized fields and propagating original caller context through HTTP/MCP/portal/X direct/research/sync/SSE/worker/replay, including cache/singleflight/artifact identity. No claim of a reachable currently shipped purpose path.
policy.capability_and_byte_bounds: Explicit candidate capability has a newly declared384000-byte request envelope (128000-byte shared state); the independent legacy control retains production128000-byte request bound. This explicit capability/interface and larger request budget are part of the new candidate mechanism, not proof of deployable fit in current JevReranker or permission to widen ordinary query-only limits. Full acceptance must implement/test bounded opt-in capability, provider identity, resource/cancellation behavior and unchanged legacy limits before any rollout.
policy.timed_request_construction: Preflight may preview every deterministic request for admission/immutable hashes. During each measured candidate phase reconstruct its actual request from frozen case/cards/variant, including canonical projection/namespacing, copies and serialization; byte-match the preview before dispatch. No prepared/serialized composite body may be substituted into measured work. Preserve both build and exchange timings and whole durable endpoint.

motivation.EXP-074: Terminal14-attempt combined deadline failure after capacity and five research operations; no quality analysis. Not retried or reinterpreted.
motivation.new_mechanism: Single transaction replaces query-only ranking with jointly requested separate query and caller-purpose Scores plus fixed rank fusion. Shared context changes judgment input; development empirically tests resulting selection against independent byte-identical W0.
motivation.prior_work: EXP018/043/045 batch other primitives/roles; EXP034/040 use one scoring rubric. Audit found no identical one-transaction query+purpose dual-Score ranking study.
